name: Rock Bottom

features.name: Stage progression
features.description: Each stage expands a character to four high.

features.name: Headshrinker and Insanity Spins
features.description: Two bonus tiers with five stages.

review:
A tribal-themed game where the free spins are all about progression. Three or four scatters start Headshrinker Spins, and more scatters lead to the bigger Insanity Spins.

Both run through five stages, and each stage turns one more character symbol into a four-high stack – so the longer the bonus lasts, the heavier the reels get. xCap and xSplit add extra twists. High volatility, 19,690x max and a 31% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
